table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	SerialNo = R.Code2,
	CustomerCode=R.Code1,
	CustomerAlias= A.AliasName,
	CustomerName= A.Name,
	cp=C.cp, 
	address1=C.address1,
	address2=C.address2, 
	city=C.city,
	StartDate = R.Date1,
	EndDate = R.Date2,
	MinSaleInvCode=Code3,
	MaxSaleInvCode=Code4,
	DiscPerc = Code5,
	SalesValue = Value1
FROM 
	ReportData R, Accounts A, Customer C
WHERE 
	R.Code1 = A.AccCode AND A.AccCode = C.CustCode
ORDER BY
	SerialNo
